The Polkit rule requires admin authentication (`auth_admin`) to control fans, which is appropriate for a utility that modifies hardware behavior. No obfuscation, network requests, downloads, eval, base64, curl, or wget are present. All file operations install into `$pkgdir`. No malicious or supply-chain attack indicators are present.
